mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 0.5% fails to produce positive 20d returns in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 7.5% indicates labor market deterioration that triggers recession fears and corporate profit downgrades, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 7.5% fails to produce negative 20d returns in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC over 2-year windows falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in retail sales (RSAFS) and payrolls (PAYEMS) above their 12-month moving averages signals robust consumer spending and labor market strength, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint signal (RSAFS and PAYEMS both above 12mo_MA) fails to produce positive 20d returns in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC over 2-year windows drops below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: Low inflation (CPIAUCSL monthly change < 0.2%) combined with ultra-low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) creates a stable monetary environment that supports equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Regime condition (CPIAUCSL m/m < 0.2 and FEDFUNDS < 0.5) fails to produce positive 60d returns in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strengthening residential construction and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through immediate demand effects.
failure_condition: HOUST fails to predict positive 5d returns in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC over 2-year windows falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100.0 (base 2017=100) signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and earnings, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100.0 fails to produce negative 20d returns in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC over 3-year windows drops below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Ultra-low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) combined with high unemployment (UNRATE > 7.0%) signals aggressive monetary policy response to economic weakness, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as recovery expectations rise.
failure_condition: Joint condition (FEDFUNDS < 0.5 and UNRATE > 7.0) fails to produce positive 20d returns in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC over 2-year windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 99.0 (base 2017=100) with consecutive monthly declines signals acute supply shock that reduces corporate margins and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Supply shock condition (INDPRO < 99.0 and INDPRO < INDPRO_prev) fails to produce negative 60d returns in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.02.
